events.description: Released new plastic exceeding ABS in carbon emissions, heat, and impact durability
Began effort to revamp fiber operations (moved production to Thailand); ultimately unsuccessful
Announced withdrawal from textile/fiber businesses; formal restructuring plan published under REVIC support

Cancelled all Class A and Class B shares; issued Class C preferred shares to REVIC via third-party allotment; REVIC takes 66.76% voting rights via ¥20B injection. Lenders (MUFG, Mizuho, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust) approve up to ¥43B debt forgiveness.
FY3/25 results released — Revenue ¥126.4B (+6.8%), OP ¥5.9B (vs -¥2.5B), Net Loss ¥(24.3)B driven by ¥37.9B impairment
FY3/25 earnings call — CEO Fujii Minoru details price revisions, cost-down, SE Asia withdrawal
Target deadline for agreeing all FY3/26 divestiture and production-transfer deals in structural-reform segments
Executed company split agreement with a wholly owned subsidiary
DIC × Unitika joint PPS film for mmWave applications announced at CES 2026; targets next-gen comms PCBs and mmWave radar
Q3 FY3/26 results — 9M cumulative Revenue ¥95.6B (+2.2%), OP ¥9.0B (+110.3%), equity ratio 25.2%
